CA.rationale: A processing-origin label (command_estimate) is explicitly attached to the same candidate content coordinates, linking processing condition to content presentation/access.

COD.rationale: Content coordinates are presented alongside explicit origin/representation metadata, separating identification from organization/access status.

A.rationale: Origin/process labels (command_estimate, inherited_current) are explicitly tied to the same content items, indicating processing/allocation conditions linked to content presentation/access.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content coordinate assignments identify items and their attributes (red/blue) for named referents.

D.rationale: Content coordinates and separate origin/representation metadata are both present, distinguishing identification from presentation/access status.

O.rationale: The text states how coordinates are oriented and attaches origin/representation metadata to content items, describing presentation/access organization.
